content.comment_body: The package of [product_name] includes a disk labeled "[article_no]". However, this disk is rectangular rather than the typical round disk shape. Due to its unusual physical size, I couldn't find a drive that can read it. Does anyone know what is stored on it and how can I download its content?
Hello, it contains open source information. I've attached a copy of it: For reference, I use an LG external disk drive and have no trouble reading this DVD. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: A user had trouble accessing information stored on a uniquely shaped disk included with [product_name]. The rectangular format made it incompatible with standard disk drives, creating uncertainty about its contents and how to obtain the data.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to easily access all provided product materials using standard hardware and to clearly understand the purpose and content of each included medium.
